messages:
Ana M (PM): Quick heads-up — customer demo in 3 weeks. We need to finalize what’s actually in the MVP vs what slides into v1. Demo must show multi-tenant routing + stable latency; everything else can be trimmed.

Josh L (Eng): Understood. Are we agreed that embeddings cache + experimental quantized path are v1 candidates? They add ~3 sprint work.

Lia C (Eng-ML): embeddings cache is higher ROI for demo scenarios where we serve many similar requests. But building it properly touches routing and eviction policy. Could we ship a simple prefix cache for the demo instead of full cache?

Ana M (PM): Proposal: MVP = routing, core runtime, canary model pinning, basic telemetry. Demo-friendly cut: lightweight prefix cache (fast to implement) and no quantization path. v1 = full embeddings cache + quantization. Thoughts?

Sanjay R (Design): For the demo UX we can fake longer flows with deterministic fallbacks if the cache isn't perfect. But we should be explicit in the demo script about limits.

Morgan P (Solutions): Customer success flagged that predictable latency > absolute cost savings for them. A simple prefix cache sounds good. I'll prep the slide noting cache is "demo-optimised, not production-grade".

Josh L (Eng): Implementation notes: prefix cache sketch -> in-memory LRU keyed by prefix hash, TTL 2 min, eviction at 2000 entries. I can spike this in a day, but integrating with smart routing + tracing will need another 2-3 days.

Lia C (Eng-ML): Suggest we scope the spike to only the text-generation path for the demo tenant. That reduces test surface and lets us toggle it per-tenant.

Ana M (PM): Good. Decision: MVP will include prefix cache limited to demo tenant, no quantized path. Action items: Josh -> spike + toggle flag; Lia -> add perf tests for generation path; Morgan -> update demo script.

Josh L (Eng): On it. I'll push a draft PR to the demo branch and ping for review.

deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy at 2023-11-02T09:30 UTC for the demo branch.

Morgan P (Solutions): Also, customer asked about A/B canary for model pinning. Can we show a canary toggle in the console for the demo?

Lia C (Eng-ML): Console toggle exists but we need to wire it to canary policy and show metrics. Minimal path: toggle + simple latency chart for that route. I can add a mocked metric if we can't surface real-time in time.

Ana M (PM): OK — mock metrics allowed for the demo, but label them. Final acceptance checklist for demo (short):
- routing + model pinning toggle (work: Lia)
- prefix cache (demo tenant only) (work: Josh)
- demo script + slide noting tradeoffs (work: Morgan)
- mark quantization + global embeddings cache as v1 backlog (PM owns)

Josh L (Eng): Estimated time: spike 1d, integrate + tests 3d, review 1d -> total ~5 working days.

Ana M (PM): Timeline fits. We start spike tomorrow. If blockers appear, @Josh L please flag in this thread.

Sanjay R (Design): I'll draft a UI microflow for the canary toggle and send comments.

Morgan P (Solutions): I'll coordinate with the customer to set expectations on what will be demoed vs committed for v1.

Ana M (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene EOD Friday for a quick scope-check. :thumbsup:

Josh L (Eng): :thumbsup:
